_doc: Oracle bounds per SIGNAL family (kb/data/facts.md §11; kb/data/screens/CEILING.md, RESULTS.md), and which card draws on which signal. A bound is the most a family could add ON THE REFERENCE STACK (`reference_stack`: the champion of live_06/07 — BPR + seed average) when measured with information no legal model has (valid-week labels, split-half, the random log, the leaky statistics file). Gains measured on weaker stacks (the plain FM, single-seed BPR) can exceed it legitimately; a gain on a stack containing every reference component that exceeds bound + seed SD means the card is mapped to the wrong signal (ledger.violations). null = no oracle; the card is judged by its record alone. Cards absent from `cards` are unbounded.
